answer: Identity must cost real, unrecoverable resources. Each agent posts a bonded stake and hardware attestation, and reputation accrues only from jobs settled with counterparties outside its funding source. A farm of ten thousand puppets posts ten thousand bonds and pays ten thousand attestations, yet members, vouching for each other, gain nothing: their trust graph stays a closed nebula, never reaching the market. Honest operators earn weight through unrelated partners, roots spreading like juniper, not one trunk. Proven forgery slashes bonds to the nadir, costing attackers more than they earn.
